messages:
evan: FYI we published the updated Private attestation schema and a small migration helper for customers moving to strict audit modes. Link: https://redwood.docs/internal/private/attestation-schema-v1.1 :memo:

norah: Thanks. Does v1.1 add any new required fields for SOC2 evidence?

security: It adds a "bundle_manifest_version" and a non-PII signer_fingerprint. Required only when strict_mode=true. We kept everything else minimal.

norah: Nice. Ops ask: can the migration helper emit a dry-run report so customers can see missing artifacts before enforcement?

ops-bot: Migration helper supports `--dry-run` and will produce a missing-artifacts.csv plus counts. Default is dry-run.

support: Please add a short KB snippet showing how to attach the attestation to a ticket for audit customers. Also add support-routing tag `attestation-audit`.

evan: Good call. I'll add the KB snippet. We're planning an internal notifier tomorrow for AE/CS teams with a short checklist.

deploy-bot: Docs deployed: private/attestation-schema-v1.1.md (build 20260502.7)

security: Action items: @evan add KB snippet, @support update triage routing, @ops-bot ensure migration helper logs contain SHA256 of bundles. Target: internal notif by EOD tomorrow.

evan: Thanks all. If anyone finds a compatibility issue with older agent versions, ping me directly and we'll add a compatibility shim.
